title: DYNATRON® STANDARD BODY FILLERS – DynaLite® Body Filler/GAL
description: Standard fillers are the economical choice for gap filling, fairing, smoothing, and general repair. They are also great for plug, pattern, crating and building shapes, curves and intricate elements to mold. They are easy to mix, apply and sand. They have a quick cure time. Great for quick repairs to fiberglass, wood, metal and aluminum.
